#### PR description:
in DQMOffline/JetMET/python/metDQMConfig_cfi.py 
Replaced improperly spelled JetCorrections with the correct spelling ( was missing L1Fast) for PuppiMet

In Validation/RRecoJets/python/JetValidation_cfi.py
Removed unused objects that have been usunsed since 2019
added JetAnalyzerAk4PFPUPPI for RECO level validations of Phase 2 detectors

In Validation/RRecoJets/python/JetValidation_cff.py
Added JetAnalyzerAk4PFPUPPI into Sequence

In Validation/RecoJets/plugins/JetTester.cc
Modified Eta range from (-6 to 6) to (-5 to 5) 
Modifed Pt range from (50 bins, 0 GeV, 500 GeV) to (700 bins, 0 GeV, 7000 GeV)
both changes are for syncing with DQM and BTV for Phase 2 changes.

In Validation/RecoJets/plugins/JetTester.h
Modified Eta range to match jettester.cc

No tests have been run
